The Studio

A premium color studio on the Magnolia Ave strip

Steel on Magnolia sits at 1314 Alston Ave, on Fort Worth's beloved Magnolia Avenue strip — a calm, light-filled studio built around one thing: beautiful color.

From lived-in balayage and bronde to full color correction and Brazilian blowouts, every appointment starts with your hair goals and ends with a finish that grows out gracefully.
